name: Job Hunter
description: Checks the job boards of the companies you care about every 6 hours, sends one digest of new matching roles, and runs your application pipeline: interviews, follow-ups, offers.

settings.label: Companies to watch
settings.help: One per line: the company's board name and where it posts jobs (greenhouse, lever or ashby). Example: stripe greenhouse

settings.label: Title keywords
settings.help: Comma list; a job title must contain one of them. Example: backend, platform, data engineer

settings.label: Skip titles with
settings.help: Comma list of words that rule a job out. Example: intern, staff, manager

settings.label: Locations
settings.help: Comma list; leave empty for anywhere. "remote" matches remote jobs. Example: remote, new york, london
